subsystems.name: Sensing and metering
subsystems.role: measure electricity flows, voltage, and power quality across the grid and at customer premises.

subsystems.name: Communications
subsystems.role: carry measurement and control data reliably and securely.

subsystems.name: Control and automation
subsystems.role: automatically reconfigure the network and manage supply and demand in real time.

subsystems.name: Data and analytics
subsystems.role: forecast demand and renewable output, detect faults, and optimise flows.

subsystems.name: Distributed energy resource (DER) integration
subsystems.role: coordinate rooftop solar, batteries, electric vehicles and microgrids with the bulk grid.

subsystems.name: Cybersecurity and resilience
subsystems.role: protect the grid from cyber and physical threats and keep it running during failures.

buildSteps.title: Map the existing grid
buildSteps.detail: Record every substation, feeder, transformer and customer connection to create a digital model.

buildSteps.title: Deploy smart meters
buildSteps.detail: Replace electromechanical meters with two-way communicating units at homes and businesses, enabling remote reading and outage detection.

buildSteps.title: Build the communications layer
buildSteps.detail: Lay fibre to substations, and use cellular or radio mesh to reach field devices and meters.

buildSteps.title: Instrument the network
buildSteps.detail: Install sensors, automated switches and voltage regulators on distribution feeders and transformers.

buildSteps.title: Upgrade control centres
buildSteps.detail: Install SCADA, distribution management and outage management software, with redundant servers and backup sites.

buildSteps.title: Integrate distributed resources
buildSteps.detail: Connect solar, batteries and EV chargers through standard interfaces so they can be monitored and curtailed or dispatched.

buildSteps.title: Test and validate
buildSteps.detail: Run cyber-security audits, simulate faults, and verify that the system can island and restore sections safely.

buildSteps.title: Operate and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Use field data to refine forecasting and automation, and roll out new services such as time-of-use pricing or demand response.

prerequisites.why: they provide the granular consumption and voltage data that most smart grid functions rely on.

prerequisites.tech: Grid-scale energy storage and flexible demand
prerequisites.why: they let the grid shift load to match variable renewable generation.
connecting legacy equipment to networks exposes it to attacks; securing it is an ongoing effort.
weather and load forecasts are already used, but need to be integrated into real-time control at scale.

pathway.milestone: widespread smart metering and automated outage detection
pathway.unlocks: better billing, faster fault location and basic demand response.

pathway.milestone: automated distribution networks that reconfigure themselves after faults
pathway.unlocks: fewer and shorter outages, and more hosting capacity for rooftop solar.

pathway.milestone: virtual power plants aggregating millions of home batteries and EVs
pathway.unlocks: grid-scale flexibility without building new peaking plants.

pathway.milestone: transactive energy markets where devices trade power locally
pathway.unlocks: efficient, resilient grids that balance supply and demand in real time.
